ITEM.PTXT: Stainless steel exhaust manifold and exhaust pipes have been adopted to reduce weight and improve corrosion resistance.

Three-way catalysts are located directly below the exhaust manifolds (integrated with the exhaust manifolds) and at the sub muffler (integrated with the sub muffler) to reduce emissions from immediately after engine start (when cold), and by ensuring sufficient emission performance, the vehicle complies with the "75% Reduction Level from Year 17 Emission Standards (SU-LEV)".

The A/F sensor is located upstream of the three-way catalyst in the exhaust manifold, and the O2sensor is located downstream of the three-way catalyst in the exhaust manifold, enabling precise air-fuel ratio control.

By adopting a stainless steel sheet exhaust manifold, weight has been reduced and corrosion resistance improved, and catalyst warm-up immediately after engine start has been accelerated to reduce emissions.
A three-way catalyst integrated with the exhaust manifold has been adopted. This speeds up warm-up of the catalytic converter, reducing emissions from immediately after engine start.
A heat insulator is provided to cover the manifold.
The exhaust gas flow has been optimized to reduce exhaust pressure loss, increasing output.
Stainless steel exhaust pipes with excellent heat resistance have been adopted.
Ball joint mechanisms have been adopted between center pipe No.1 and center pipe No.2, and between center pipe No.2 and the tail pipe, reducing booming noise in the cabin, weight and vibration.
The ball joint mechanism consists of a flange with a spherical surface, and bolts and springs that support the seal portion of the gasket. It can be made more compact than a flexible pipe.
Vibration and noise are reduced by absorbing vibration from the engine and resonance vibration of the exhaust pipe with the ball joint (spherical portion of the flange and gasket).

By placing 1 three-way catalysts in each exhaust manifold and 1 three-way catalyst in the sub muffler, and by optimizing the shape (volume and wall thickness) of the ceramic substrate and the use of catalyst components, the "75% Reduction Level from Year 17 Emission Standards" (SU-LEV) has been achieved.

A 2WAY exhaust system has been adopted for the main muffler to improve exhaust efficiency and engine output while ensuring quietness. In the 2WAY exhaust system, a variable valve that adjusts the exhaust gas passage area according to exhaust gas pressure is provided inside the main muffler. The variable valve is kept closed by a return spring during idling and at low engine speeds.
A sub muffler with an integrated catalyst has been adopted, securing underfloor space and improving exhaust silencing.

ENTRY.PTXT: Because the exhaust gas pressure in the main muffler is low, the variable valve is closed, reducing booming noise, and the muffler functions with emphasis on silencing.

When the exhaust gas pressure in the main muffler increases as the engine speed increases, the variable valve opens to enlarge the passage, and the muffler functions as a low back pressure, high output type muffler.
